Olive Chen: Hello! Im Olive, joining as Data Platform Eng. Day 0 excitement  quick Qs: who do I ping for repo access + VPN? Also curious where to pick up the badge and if plants are a thing. :seedling:
Ramesh Iyer: welcome Olive!! for VPN/repo ping #eng-infra and drop your public key if you want it pre-authorized. Badge pickup is reception after 10:30. Plant: yes we do a small plant drop by default  reply plant: prefer if you want a specific one.
Olive Chen: thanks Ramesh. dropping pubkey to speed things up:
````
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFakeKeyOlive olive@home
````
Juno Park: hi Olive  Juno from product. Lunch meeting at 12 if youre around  we usually do a quick intro. Also two truths/lie for fun: I once dog-sat for a cheetah (ok not really), I can juggle, Im allergic to kiwi.
Olive Chen: fun  Ill guess: juggling true, kiwi allergy lie, cheetah story exaggerated.
Ramesh Iyer: infra note: we received the key, starting pre-auth. If you hit a 403 after SSO, @eng-infra-bot will create a support ticket automatically  but feel free to ping me directly. Preferred OS?
Olive Chen: macOS. Also plant: prefer pothos if available. Also small ask: standing desk converter if possible.
FacilitiesBot: Olive Chen  desk assigned: 2B-11. Badge pickup: reception after 10:30 under your full name. Plant request: pothos queued. Converter request: queued as "desk: standing". If you need a headset left at reception reply headset: yes.
eng-infra-bot: SSH key attached to Olive Chen. Repository access scheduled. If provisioning fails a ticket will be opened as IT-5301.
OnboarderBot: Welcome Olive Chen! New hire packet sent. Reminders: security training due by day 5, benefits invite sent. 1:1 with manager scheduled at 3177810000.
Olive Chen: awesome, thank you all  Ill join the 12pm lunch and DM Ramesh if anything blocks. See you soon :wave:
